document.about: Herman Miller Aeron product sheet. Its Key Features are one list numbered 1 to 6, run on from one column into the next, with the photo's callout numbers read between the columns.

notes: #275: the photo's callouts between the columns ended the list, so the features came out as two lists, 1 to 3 and 4 to 6.
